evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/cache/b/f as rs.cache.updater.BrowserHyperlinkListener.
Exact v308 class implements javax.swing.event.HyperlinkListener and reacts only to ACTIVATED events by browsing the event URL through Desktop.getDesktop().browse(URI.create(...)).

R23 AssetVersion constructs this listener on the JEditorPane used by its connection/update error dialog containing the SpawnPK forums hyperlink; the class has no unrelated state beyond its synthetic AssetVersion owner reference.

candidates.note: Source-proven asset/update browser-link listener with exact-v308 behavioral corroboration.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/f/a as rs.Configuration.

Exact v308 rs/f/a is a global static configuration holder with a very large settings surface spanning server/client mode, rendering/gameframe, updater, developer-console and feature toggles; it is not an instance-domain model.

Exact dependency analysis finds direct rs/f/a references from over one hundred project classes including Client, Launcher, definitions, cache updaters, renderers, overlays and UI subsystems, proving it is live global client configuration authority.
The exact constant pool preserves configuration-oriented literals including developer_console and updater/runtime configuration values, independently matching the source-map identity.

candidates.note: Source-proven global client Configuration class. No individual field semantics are proposed by this batch.
